sources.title: N0-TWAM - Scaling Tactile-Native World Action Model for Contact-Rich ...
sources.snippet: ${\mathcal{N}}_{0}$ -TWAM is pretrained at scale with synchronized per-finger tactile streams. Three modality experts predict future vision and contact before producing the action. A Tactile-Native World Action Model The model predicts three coupled streams for each chunk: future video, future tactile, and action.

sources.snippet: N 0 -TWAM is a Vision-Tactile-Action world-action model. Vision, tactile, and action are jointly modeled by a Mixture-of-Transformers under a single rectified-flow / flow-matching objective — the model predicts the visual and tactile future and generates the low-level action that realizes it.

sources.title: [2607.23783] $N_0$-TWAM: Scaling Tactile-Native World-Action Model for ...
sources.snippet: We present N0 -TWAM, a tactile-native world-action model for contact-rich manipulation that predicts both future vision and future contact. To our knowledge, it is the first tactile world-action model trained at large scale, and it shows strong capability on contact-rich tasks.
